issue.title: Align Spark model-completion provider label
issue.description: Discovered while verifying sase-bn. tests/test_xprompt_model_completion.py::test_model_completion_catalog_reflects_real_builtin_model_metadata fails both in the 22-worker non-visual suite and in isolation: the catalog renders 'codex (gpt53spark)' while the test expects 'Codex (gpt53spark)'. Determine whether registry metadata or the assertion owns provider-label capitalization, then make them consistent.
